name: freshness-tracks-db-jsonl-agreement
body: The freshness fast path must not declare a `db.lbug` fresh when it disagrees with the `graph.jsonl` recorded for it: a recorded scan re-anchored ahead of the DB's own `Scan` row must not let a later `apg scan` reuse a DB whose authored/transient rows differ from the tree's assembled graph. Any published divergence must be recoverable by re-scanning; it must never be permanently masked. (Prose; assessed by review.)
